listed_sector_signals.signal: Pulp & paper and ferrous-metals (steel) production named as sectors covered by the EU Emissions Trading Directive — mention of the sectors only, no application to them
listed_sector_signals.quote:
The Emissions Trad-
ing Directive applies primarily to large in-
dustries in the sectors of energy conversion 
and transformation, production and pro-
cessing of ferrous metals, and the paper and 
pulp industries.
listed_sector_signals.sector: pulp & paper; steel and other primary-metals continuous production

one_line: A conceptual/legal review of implementing energy management systems (ISO 50001, PDCA cycle, EU directives) in industry generally, with examples drawn from cloud data centres, general manufacturing, and Siemens electrical components (circuit-breaker, soft starter); pulp & paper and ferrous-metals are only named in the scope of the Emissions Trading Directive.
